notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 12701 (Amending Executive Order No. 12334, signed February 14, 1990, 55 FR 5953) has one operative sentence in the held Federal Register text: the second sentence of section 1 of EO 12334 "shall be deleted and the following sentence inserted in lieu thereof". That is a self-executing strike-and-insert amendment, complete on issue, and the order contains no continuing duty of its own. The inserted sentence ("One member shall be designated by the President as Chairman.") continued inside EO 12334 until EO 12863 revoked EO 12334 "as amended" (the held Federal Register text of EO 12863 reads, in its Sec. 3.3, that EO 12334 of December 4, 1981, as amended, and EO 12537 are revoked); EO 12863 does not name EO 12701, so that revocation reaches this order only through the parent and is evidence for the surviving consequence, not for this order's own end. The one history observation, the Federal Register disposition note "Amends: EO 12334, December 4, 1981", records only that this order amends another and shows no later event affecting EO 12701. Status: no.
